digest.en: Tensions rise in the Middle East as Germany criticizes Iran for holding the world hostage after an attack on the UAE. Meanwhile, Putin and Zelensky declare rival ceasefires ahead of a Moscow parade. Oil prices surge amid violence in the Strait of Hormuz.

articles.title: "Stop Holding World Hostage," Germany Tells Iran After UAE Attacked
articles.summary: Germany's foreign minister told Iran to stop holding the world hostage after the UAE was attacked, amid rising tensions in the region. The UAE attack has heightened concerns about Iran's involvement in regional conflicts.

articles.title: Das Adam Smith Problem: rethinking Smith’s moral and economic worlds
articles.summary: Scholars view Adam Smith's philosophy as a coherent whole uniting ethics and economics, not a dichotomy between sympathy and self-interest. The Das Adam Smith Problem shows an apparent dichotomy between sympathy and self-interest in Adam Smith’s works, but most scholars now view it as a misunderstanding, arguing that his philosophy forms a coherent whole uniting ethics and economics.
